findings.description: URL injection vulnerability: Transcript ID interpolated directly into URL string without sanitization. Pattern: URL(string: "https://api.assemblyai.com/v2/transcript/\(id)"). Attackers could inject path traversal or query parameters.
findings.remediation: Use URLComponents with percent encoding: var components = URLComponents(string: "https://api.assemblyai.com/v2/transcript"); components?.path = "/" + id.addingPercentEncoding(withAllowedCharacters: .urlPathAllowed); guard let pollURL = components?.url else { throw TranscriptionError.invalidTranscriptID }

findings.description: URL injection vulnerability: Transcript ID directly interpolated into URL without validation or encoding.
findings.remediation: Replace string interpolation with URLComponents and percent-encode the id parameter

findings.description: URL injection via string concatenation: baseURL and filename concatenated without validation. Could allow path traversal if filename contains '../'.
findings.remediation: Use URL.appendingPathComponent(): guard let url = base?.appendingPathComponent(filename) else { throw ModelDownloadError.invalidURL }

findings.description: API key exposure via plain String: API key returned as String from Keychain, can appear in memory dumps and crash logs.
findings.remediation: Implement SecureString wrapper with encrypted memory storage and withDecryptedValue access pattern

findings.description: API key property exposes plain String: apiKey property returns String? which remains in memory until garbage collected.
findings.remediation: Replace String? with SecureString that stores encrypted and provides withSecureAccess pattern

findings.description: API key stored as plain String property: private let apiKey: String stores API key in plain memory extractable from memory dumps.
findings.remediation: Use SecureString wrapper with encrypted memory storage and explicit cleanup in deinit

findings.description: O(n) array shift in VAD loop: vadBuffer.removeFirst(vadReadIndex) triggers array reallocation and memory copy every VAD chunk (every 256ms), causing O(n^2) total complexity.
findings.remediation: Replace Array with CircularBuffer: private var vadBuffer = CircularAudioBuffer(capacity: 16000 * 10). Avoids O(n) shift.

findings.description: Unbounded array growth for speech samples: speechSamples.append has no upper bound. For 2-hour meeting = 115M samples = ~460MB memory, can cause memory pressure crash.
findings.remediation: Use fixed-size circular buffer with flush every 30 seconds via CircularAudioBuffer

findings.description: Defer with async Task is unreliable for cleanup. Fire-and-forget Task may not execute before process termination or resource cleanup. No guarantee buffers are returned to pool.
findings.remediation: Use explicit cleanup in do-catch-finally pattern instead of defer with async Task

findings.description: Fire-and-forget Task in actor init creates race condition. Task may execute after other init code runs, causing inconsistent state.
findings.remediation: Remove fire-and-forget Task. Make init async or use @MainActor init. Consider factory pattern for async initialization.

findings.description: Defer with async operations is unreliable in Swift. The defer block creates a Task for async buffer release, but defer runs when function exits - Task may not complete properly.
findings.remediation: Replace defer with explicit cleanup: do { ... } catch { ... } await bufferPool.release(&micBuffer)

findings.description: run() method CCN 29 exceeds threshold of 15. Method is 130+ lines with nested if/else, switch statements, and async calls. High complexity makes testing difficult.
findings.remediation: Extract methods: processVADState(), handleSpeechStart(), handleSpeechEnd(), processPartialTranscription(). Reduces run() to ~30 lines.

findings.description: transcribeFile() method CCN 26 exceeds threshold. 100+ line method with validation, upload, polling, and error handling intertwined.
findings.remediation: Split into phase methods: uploadPhase(), createTranscriptPhase(), pollPhase(). Each < 30 lines.

findings.description: mergeStreams() method CCN 22 exceeds threshold. Complex async stream handling with multiple nested loops and buffer management. 95+ lines.
findings.remediation: Extract stream filling logic: fillBuffer(from:into:count:); Extract mixing: mixAndWrite(mic:sys:micCount:sysCount:)

findings.description: Force unwrapped URL creation. URL(string:) force unwrap without validation could crash if URL becomes invalid through future changes.
findings.remediation: Use guard let with proper error handling instead of force unwrap

findings.description: Scalar deinterleave loop in convertToMono should use vDSP_deqinterleave for vectorized processing.
findings.remediation: Use vDSP_deqinterleave(src.baseAddress!, &leftChannel, &rightChannel, vDSP_Length(frameCount), 2)

findings.description: Scalar channel extraction in extractFloatSamples is O(n*m) instead of using vDSP or memcpy.
findings.remediation: Use memcpy for contiguous blocks: memcpy(&samples[channel * frameLength], channelData[channel], frameLength * MemoryLayout<Float>.size)

findings.description: Scalar mixing in mixToMono is O(n*m) scalar loop instead of vDSP vectorized operations.
findings.remediation: Use vDSP for mixing with weight array and vectorized sum operations

findings.description: @unchecked Sendable on actor is redundant. Actors are implicitly Sendable in Swift 6.
findings.remediation: Remove @unchecked Sendable from actor declaration

findings.description: Error? is not Sendable. Storing Error directly breaks Swift 6 concurrency checks.
findings.remediation: Create TranscriptionErrorInfo struct with String description instead of Error

findings.description: [weak self] in actor-isolated context is unnecessary and potentially problematic. Weak capture could prevent progress updates.
findings.remediation: Remove [weak self] - actors don't need weak capture for internal closures

immediate: Fix all 3 URL injection vulnerabilities with URLComponents
Fix defer+async in StreamingBufferProtocols with explicit cleanup
Add bounds checking to speechSamples array in StreamingTranscriber
before_merge: Implement SecureString for API key storage
Fix DIContainer race condition in initialization
Replace scalar DSP loops with vDSP operations
Reduce complexity in run() and transcribeFile() methods
follow_up: Add comprehensive security tests for URL construction
Add memory pressure tests for long recordings
